events.title: UNFROST Demo Is Out!
events.summary: The UNFROST demo is finally available on Steam, and we're excited to be part of Steam Next Fest! We invite you to head to Antarctica, explore the unknown, and try the game for yourself! ⚠️ A quick heads-up: This is an early version of UNFROST, so you might run into some bugs, glitches, or other issues. Please bear with us while we keep improving the game! We'd love to hear your feedback!Your thoughts will help us make UNFROST better. You can fill out our feedback form here:https://forms.gle/uwVT

events.title: 40000 Wishlists!
events.summary: UNFROST has now reached 40000 wishlists on Steam!A huge thank you to everyone who has followed the game, wishlisted it, shared our trailer, or simply told someone about UNFROST. Your support means a lot to our team.We’re actively working on the game and preparing the next steps.More UNFROST news is coming soon. Stay tuned!

events.title: Playtest Sign-Ups Are Open!
events.summary: Hey everyone!First of all - thank you so much for all the support UNFROST has received since the announcement. Seeing your reactions, comments, wishlists, and interest in the game means a lot to our team.And now it’s time for the next step:Sign-ups for the UNFROST closed playtest are officially open!You can request access directly from the UNFROST Steam page.The game is still in active development, so we won’t be inviting everyone at once.
